high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "tatacliq." The post features a sponsored advertisement for the "Bentley Infinite Intense Eau de Parfum for Men - 100 ml." The main object in the image is a perfume bottle with a sleek, modern design. The bottle is transparent, allowing the light-colored liquid inside to be visible. The cap is metallic silver, and the label on the front prominently displays the Bentley logo, which consists of a winged "B" emblem. Below the logo, the words "BENTLEY INFINITE INTENSE" are written in bold
